channel.title: Signet Artists — Blog
channel.description: Occasional writing on live music for private events: planning it, pricing it, and the music itself. From Signet Artists in Denver.

item.title: Where to hold a corporate holiday party in Denver in 2026
item.description: Sixteen Denver corporate holiday party venues for 2026, sized from 40 to 3,500 guests, with published capacities, the fine print planners hit, and the live-music read on each.

item.title: What changes when the reception is outdoors
item.description: Planning a live band for an outdoor reception in Colorado: generator and circuit requirements, cover, the weather decision, and the state noise caps measured at the property line.

item.title: What live music costs for a corporate event
item.description: How a live band's price for a corporate event is built: call-out plus hourly, worked totals from duo to quartet, and what travel and holiday dates add.

item.title: What a band needs from the venue
item.description: Stage size, electrical circuits, load-in and insurance paperwork for a live band at a corporate event, with published stage dimensions compared against what a duo, trio, quartet and DJ actually ask for.

item.title: Playing around a program
item.description: How a live band works around a corporate program: remarks, award walk-ons, auctions, video packages and the volume shift, with who cues each moment.
